alt.en: Three cat astronauts on a rocky Mars ridge at dawn, looking toward the Hope-1 outpost.
alt.zh-TW: 三隻貓太空人黎明時站在火星岩脊上，望向希望一號基地。

assets.note: key art / title; re-rolled 2026-11-14 without the tomato beside Ginger

alt.en: The three cat astronauts in a lineup on a metallic hangar floor.
alt.zh-TW: 三隻貓太空人在金屬機棚中並排站立。

alt.en: The three cats stand in front of their smoking crashed spacecraft, with shattered solar panels on the dusty ground.
alt.zh-TW: 三隻貓站在冒煙的迫降太空船前，地上是碎裂的太陽能板。

assets.note: opening / crash site; re-rolled 2026-11-14 without the US flag decal, then again without the tomato, then once more with a true post-crash shot

alt.en: Exterior view of the Hope-1 Mars outpost with its dome, solar farm and rover.
alt.zh-TW: 希望一號火星基地外觀，含圓頂、太陽能陣列與探測車。

alt.en: The three cats inside a cozy Mars habitat control room with a holographic display.
alt.zh-TW: 三隻貓在溫暖的火星基地控制室裡，前方有全像顯示器。

alt.en: Ginger the orange cat among tomato seedlings in the greenhouse under pink grow lights.
alt.zh-TW: 橘貓金桔坐在溫室番茄幼苗間，頭頂是粉紫色植物燈。

alt.en: Shadow repairs a solar panel at night while Silver watches and Ginger waits in the rover.
alt.zh-TW: 暗影在夜間維修太陽能板，銀白在下方守候，金桔在探測車內等待。

alt.en: A rover crosses a frost-dusted Martian plain with Shadow and Ginger inside.
alt.zh-TW: 探測車駛過結霜的火星平原，暗影與金桔坐在車內。

alt.en: The three cats gather around a holographic report in a warm debrief room.
alt.zh-TW: 三隻貓在溫暖的任務覆盤室裡圍著全像報告。

alt.en: A supply ship descends toward the landing pad as the three cats watch at sunrise.
alt.zh-TW: 補給船在日出時降落在停機坪，三隻貓在一旁觀看。

assets.note: ending; re-rolled 2026-11-14 without the tomato crate (tomatoes would freeze on the surface) and without the US flag decal

alt.zh-TW: 空無一貓的基地控制室，有弧形全像顯示器與一箱番茄。

alt.zh-TW: 空無一貓的溫室，番茄幼苗、自動澆水臂與檯面上的一顆熟番茄。

alt.en: A solar panel array under the night sky with a repair drone and a portable light pod, no crew.
alt.zh-TW: 夜空下的太陽能陣列，有維修無人機與行動燈具，畫面中沒有貓。

alt.en: A frost-dusted Martian plain with fresh rover tracks and a thin dust devil at dawn; no rover in frame.
alt.zh-TW: 覆霜的火星平原，有新的探測車車轍與遠方細長塵捲風；畫面中沒有探測車。

assets.note: background plate candidate (no rover, no cats), 2026-11-14; scene 11 is offered only as rover+crew or as this empty landscape — no empty-cabin version

alt.zh-TW: 日出時補給船降向停機坪，畫面中沒有貓。

alt.zh-TW: 黃昏時清理乾淨的太陽能陣列，背後是基地圓頂，畫面中沒有貓。

alt.en: At night Shadow in a dark suit inspects a fresh puncture in the habitat module, dust drifting from the hole while a small repair drone hovers and the base windows glow behind.
alt.zh-TW: 夜裡暗影穿著深色太空衣，檢查基地艙壁上新被擊穿的破洞，粉塵從洞口飄出，維修無人機浮在旁邊，背後的艙窗亮著燈。

assets.note: event card S2 / micrometeorite breach / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: At night the opened oxygen unit glows cyan while a small repair robot works on its pipes, amber status lights above, Shadow sitting beside it.
alt.zh-TW: 夜裡的基地內部，氧氣回收機的艙門打開、內部透著青光，小型維修機器人伸著工具手臂檢修管線，上方亮著橙色狀態燈，暗影坐在一旁看著。

assets.note: event card L1 / oxygen unit repair / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: Silver in a white suit tests the green-lit control panel beside the shelter’s heavy round hatch, folded blankets and storage crates on the shelves around.
alt.zh-TW: 銀白穿著白色太空衣，用前掌按下避難艙厚重圓門旁亮著綠燈的控制面板，兩側架上放著毯子與收納箱。

assets.note: event card S3 / shelter hatch check / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: Ginger crouches by a dripping, corroded pipe joint in the greenhouse corridor while a robotic arm tightens the fitting and water falls into a metal bowl, pink grow lights and seedlings behind.
alt.zh-TW: 金桔蹲在溫室走道漏水、生鏽的水管接頭旁，機械臂正轉緊接頭，水滴落進下方的金屬盆，背後是粉紫植物燈與幼苗。

assets.note: event card L2 / clogged water line / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: At golden hour Ginger taps the cargo console beside an empty supply cradle, stacked crates by the open hatch and a rover out on the plain behind.
alt.zh-TW: 黃昏時金桔按著貨運控制台，旁邊是空著的補給托架，敞開的艙口旁堆著補給箱，遠處平原上有一台探測車。

assets.note: event card F3 / delayed supply crate / added and re-rolled without the US flag patch 2026-11-14

alt.en: Silver sits before an open carbon-dioxide scrubber with one front paw on a low control panel, a spare filter cartridge on the floor, its screen showing bars and molecule symbols.
alt.zh-TW: 銀白坐在敞開濾芯艙門的二氧化碳洗滌器前，前掌按著低矮的控制面板，地上放著備用濾芯，螢幕顯示濃度條與分子符號。

assets.note: event card L3 / CO2 scrubber / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: An empty life-support bay with a carbon-dioxide scrubber, its round filter housing open and a spare cartridge on the floor, bars and molecule symbols on the screen; no crew.
alt.zh-TW: 空無一貓的生命維持艙，二氧化碳洗滌器的圓形濾芯艙門敞開，地上放著備用濾芯，螢幕顯示濃度條與分子符號。

alt.en: Shadow stands on a dust-covered solar panel at night, visor scanning the glass, while Silver watches from the ground and Ginger waits inside the rover.
alt.zh-TW: 夜裡，暗影站在積滿沙塵的太陽能板上，護目鏡掃描著板面；銀白在下方地面守候，金桔坐在探測車裡等待。

assets.note: event card P1 / night dust on the solar array / added 2026-11-14

alt.en: A dust-covered solar panel array under the night sky, lit by a portable lamp, the outpost dome glowing in the distance and an empty rover parked nearby; no crew.
alt.zh-TW: 星空下積滿沙塵的太陽能陣列，行動燈具照亮板面，遠處基地圓頂亮著，旁邊停著一輛空著的探測車；畫面中沒有貓。
